description: This file defines the FavoritesController class for managing favorite articles in an ASP.NET Core application. It includes two endpoints for adding and deleting favorite articles based on a article slug, secured with JWT authorization.

classes.name: FavoritesController
classes.description: Controller handling favorite/unfavorite actions for articles using MediatR to process commands.

methods.name: FavoriteAdd
methods.description: Handles POST request to add an article to favorites based on the slug.

methods.name: FavoriteDelete
methods.description: Handles DELETE request to remove an article from favorites based on the slug.
